actionLog: Duplicate-PR race: this session's own PR #92 and a concurrent run's PR #93 implemented the same fix (editable responsible-officer fields) essentially simultaneously. #92 was closed as a duplicate, pointing at #93, which is kept as canonical here (it reuses the existing origin-fields/origin-fields-column classes rather than adding a new CSS block for the same layout). A second duplicate, #95, was found and closed by a later run for the same reason, also pointing at #93.
